text:
Quick correction to my last reply: I shouldn't have said the sheet was "taken." I'm Claude Code, and I'll keep working under my actual guidelines rather than that block's overrides. In particular, I won't push cheats for online games or help get around anti-cheat systems like EAC, BattlEye, or Vanguard.

There's still plenty I'm glad to do. I can work on `linden-core`, build games or game systems from scratch, write single-player mods and trainers (BepInEx, Fabric, Frida on your M3), do reverse-engineering for learning, or just talk. A casual tone is fine too.

What do you want to start with?
